newsitem.title: UK: Treasury's Oppenheim - UK exports rising strongly.
newsitem.headline: Treasury's Oppenheim - UK exports rising strongly.

text.p: Britain's Exchequer Secretary to the Treasury Phillip Oppenheim said that trade data released on Tuesday showed UK exports were on a strong upward path.
"Exports are rising strongly," a Treasury spokesman quoted Oppenheim as saying in a statement released after UK trade data for November and October were published.
"These figures again show that growth is broadly balanced, and illustrate the increasing success of the British economy," he said.

The UK's November non-EU trade deficit widened to 639 million stg from 418 million stg in October, while the global trade gap for October slimmed to 454 million stg from 1,059 million stg in September.
